reviews.title: Great case!
reviews.comment: Have been turned off by all the plastic on Fractal’s other cases, but this one is nearly all metal and I love the integrated look of the fans.  Beautiful case with plenty of room for whatever you want to throw in it!  Appreciate the metal upper mesh panel—was a nice surprise.  Would have preferred 4-pin fans, but the 3-pin fans it came with are working well and nice and quiet.  Would also love to see integrated vertical mount capability in a case like this, so adding a big bulky bolt on wouldn’t be necessary to show off your video card.  Overall good build quality and I would recommend if you like the fishbowl style of this case!
reviews.author: Lucas Fisher
